commit_message: Fix managed local inference and benchmark execution
pr_title: Fix managed Local AI inference and benchmark campaigns
pr_body: Fixes the four confirmed managed Local AI gaps: move full managed integrity verification off the Editor UI thread, replace fixed 999 GPU layers with llama.cpp memory fitting, surface inference failures in Conversation, and connect benchmark campaigns to the GameEngine-managed Windows Native / WSL2 GGUF runtime while retaining compatible-backend support.
